items.title: blogin init
items.content_text: Scaffold a new site in a directory, with a starter post, layouts, and a blogin.json. What it writes builds with nothing to fill in first.

items.title: blogin new
items.content_text: Create a new post file from a title. It writes <section>/<today>-<slug>.md with title, date, an empty tags list, and an empty description filled in, the slug derived from the title.

items.title: blogin build
items.content_text: Render the content tree to static HTML, writing feeds, a sitemap, and the search index alongside the pages.

items.title: blogin serve
items.content_text: Build the site and serve it locally, rebuilding when anything under the site directory changes. blogin.json is read once at startup, so an edit to it takes effect when you restart the server. A…

items.title: blogin clean
items.content_text: Remove the output directory produced by a build, leaving the content, layouts, and configuration in place.
